mentions.h: Road Running & Cross Country - Results Roundup
Mark Miles wins AAA 5k title but Bels lose the team race on count back
The AAA 5k Road Race at Horwich

photos.c: Above: The start of the inaugural AAA 5 km Road Championship, held in conjunction with the Horwich Carnival race.  From left to right Peter Riley (107 Leigh H), Rob Whalley (90 Bristol & West AC), Andi Jones (51 Salford), David Anderson (88 Belgrave H) with Mark Miles on his left, behind Ian Mitchell (114 Tipton), the eventual winner Wilf Taragon (85 Birchfield), Mark Tucker (126 Australia), Birhan Dagne (217 Belgrave H) is on the right.  Mark Miles placed second with the fastest time run by a Briton in Britain this year – 13:58 – and took the AAA Championship.

Above: The AAA 5k Road Race was again held in Horwich. It was only the second time the Championship has been held and the Bels have medalled on each occasion – silver in 2005 and now gold in 2006. Individual AAA Champion was Chris Davies of Telford (in the red and yellow), second was Peter Riley of Leigh (white vest with green diagonal) and third was our own Mark Miles (177). Simon Jones (not pictured) and Richard Ward (181) made up the Belgrave team. The Open race was won by Birchfield, running three Africans, but they were not eligible for the AAA race.
